limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the early assertion by registering `valid_b`, but also made `ready_a` high during reset and before the first post-reset clock, and gated `valid_b` with `valid_a` instead of preserving the count-only condition.
The test exercised stalls before the sixth bit and checked reset, but its expectations mirrored the rewrite: it required `valid_b` to be low during those stalls and `ready_a` to be high during reset.
